title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Basix NEX-Forms……
description: A reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Basix NEX-Forms nex-forms-express-wp-form-builder up to version 9.3.3. This vulnerability involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing attackers to inject malicious scripts that can execute in users' browsers.
